name: New-listing (genesis-window) liquidity provision and initial price discovery
one_line: Be the first sensible quote in the ~300k markets listed per month: first-minute takers pay a median 12-16c half-spread outside sports versus ~1c a few hours later.
scope: Cover quoting in the first minutes to hours of a market's life as its own business. Hard numbers from ~160,000 contracts created Oct 2025-Mar 2026: median effective half-spread paid in the first minute 14.5c monetary policy, 12c economy, 16c geopolitics, 13.5c politics and elections, 12.5c crypto, 14c other, versus 1.5c sports; 3-6.5c at 1-6 min; ~1c by 1-3 h; most compression inside the first hour. Share of that cost the maker keeps (realised / effective, first six minutes, one-hour horizon): sports 1.00 (no rent, price discovery happened at sportsbooks), economy near 1 (scheduled releases, uninformed early takers), but geopolitics 0.25, politics 0.35, elections 0.29, other 0.33, i.e. two thirds of the opening spread there is adverse selection. Build: discovery (Gamma keyset pagination, WS new_market event), a fair-value seed per category (cross-listed Kalshi price, option surface, base rates, an LLM prior where E7 shows LLMs are least bad at Open+1), defensive sizing against informed first takers, placeholder / 'Other' handling in new neg-risk events, timing of reward-config start dates. State that the sample ends one day before Fee Structure V2 and that the authors expect rebates to compress opening spreads: re-measure before building. Boundary: steady-state quoting is event-market-making-spread-carry; pool share is maker-reward-pool-farming; new alt-coin up/down books are short-crypto-maker-side.
why_it_matters: It is the one place where the evidence says a long-tail maker is paid a wide spread rather than ~0 (the list's own event-MM entry reports a median effective half-spread of ~0 and 91% of maker profit arriving at settlement). It is capacity-constrained and engineering-heavy (discovery and seeding across 300k listings a month), which is what keeps desks out and suits a solo technical team. The category split tells the owner where not to do it (politics / geopolitics without an information source; sports, where there is no rent).

key_evidence.note: 'Opening Wide, Moving Fast: Polymarket Spread Dynamics' (Lund / IMDEA, 2026, PDF text extracted locally): Table 9 half-spreads by time bucket and category; R/E ratios; fee-free sample ending the day before Fee Structure V2
